messages:
Rae (Design): quick thread  compact preview toolbar is wrapping on small screens and the export button slips below the fold. proposing a slim sticky header that keeps legend + actions visible.
Diego (Eng): sticky header makes sense. simple DOM and preserves action visibility. downside: must ensure tab order doesn't jump when it sticks.
Mina (A11y): agree on sticky but legend swatches need accessible labels and non-color markers. color-only will fail WCAG.
Rae (Design): plan: text label + small shape icon next to each swatch, and a high-contrast toggle. also a legend collapse button that reveals full legend for cramped layouts.
Sam (PM): product note  keep export next to bulk actions in header. users export frequently and moving it caused confusion. add export size warning >10k rows.
Noah (ML): rerank score copy: show "0.83" with `aria-describedby` pointing to hidden text "Rerank score 0-1; higher=more relevant." users keep asking about scale.
Mina (A11y): yes — don't rely on hover tooltips; provide sr-only node and reference it. for live updates, use a polite summary live region only for major changes.
Diego (Eng): perf note: rendering large previews kills the DOM. cap preview to 100 rows and show banner: "Previewing 100 of 7,432 vectors  export will include all unless sampled."
Rae (Design): banner copy: "Previewing 100 of 7,432 vectors. Export all or choose a sample." must be `role=note` and keyboard dismissible (`aria-label="Dismiss preview notice"`).
Sam (PM): sampling dropdown: First N, Random (default 1000), Stratified by score. show short help text. recommend random by default.
Diego (Eng): I'll add sr-only descriptions, cap preview rows, and group actions in header. will open a PR and attach a staging preview.
deploy-bot: deploy preview for branch `design/preview-toolbar-refactor` at https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/toolbar-refactor
Rae (Design): thanks — I'll do a keyboard pass and update the mocks. Mina, can you test VO/NVDA once PR is up?
Mina (A11y): will do. blocking only if aria-describedby or live region patterns are missing.
Sam (PM): target: ship behind FF next week.
Rae (Design): :thumbsup: adding notes to the design doc.
